-- I am going DOWN!!!! -- The Last Post

October 05, 2006

Boy, life is going so fast!!
Today, I was riding my bike, on my way back from office and suddenly it struck me; man I am growing old!! I rem, not so far in past struggling with exams, college, school, bitches and assholes!! :P
And here I am, struggling with job, office, work, more bitches and max assholes!!
Shit, I am 24! And no achievements! No Space travel, no new theories, no new formulas, no new hyperbolic teleportation module to dump shit from of shit-pots to planet zorg! But, hey! I still have few years left and probably it calls for a total makeover!!
You know…! The “I have found my piece in my sole!!” thing! eh?

So I have made a totally radical decision; I am going to take this blog down!!
[At this point I hoped someone would shout; MAY-DAY; MAY-DAY!!] sigh…
Anyway.. yeah, I am not going to delete this blog; but it will be pretty much inaccessible; because I’ll hide it. anyway, there are not many readers, spare few; so whats the “noise”. eh? :|

INSTEAD, I am gonna start with somewhat a “witty” blog; More about life in a “4th Dimension” :) That is humor. Because thats what takes you to a whole new level!!

Yeah, no more “bitchslapping”…. or maybe “bitchslapping with style!!” :)

If I can get the name, the the name of new blog will be “ohlyshit.blogspot.com” :D
Like.. Jhon says … “HOW COOL IS THAT!!” [two spanks on my own ass and lil bit of swiveling!]

This is a pheonix rising, applause People.

And, hey blog!! It’s been a great great journey boy; but it’s time for extraordinary stuff! :D
Love ya.
@tom-shit! :D
